description_for_human: Search official Microsoft documentation and code samples on Microsoft Learn.
description_for_model: Retrieves official Microsoft technical documentation and code samples from Microsoft Learn. Use it for questions about Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft-published PowerShell modules, and Azure. Always use it to verify a cmdlet name, parameter name, API endpoint, permission scope, throttling behaviour, or service limit before stating it.
